POSE, CLOTHING, AND COMPOSITION

The woman stands very close behind the rain-covered glass, facing the camera with a subtle three-quarter turn. Her head is gently tilted, her shoulders relaxed, and her upper body leaning slightly toward the window. One arm is raised gracefully above her head, elbow bent, with her hand resting near her hair, creating a dramatic diagonal silhouette across the upper-left composition.

She has a slender, naturally proportioned feminine silhouette, graceful neck, narrow shoulders, and softly tapered waist. She wears an elegant dark sleeveless slip dress with delicate narrow straps, blending subtly into the surrounding shadows. Her face occupies the upper-central frame, while her softly illuminated torso extends downward. Frame her from above her head to approximately her upper thighs.

RAIN-COVERED GLASS — PRIMARY VISUAL FOCUS

A transparent glass pane completely separates the viewer from the woman. The entire foreground is covered with hundreds of extraordinarily realistic raindrops, condensation, and flowing water streaks. Include tiny spherical droplets, larger elongated drops, irregular clusters of moisture, and thick gravity-driven rivulets running vertically across the glass.

The droplets must vary naturally in size, shape, spacing, and density. Some merge into narrow streams, while others remain suspended, creating organic patterns and realistic surface tension. Warm amber light refracts through the droplets, producing sharp copper highlights, dark edges, and subtle optical distortions.

The glass and water droplets must be significantly sharper than the woman behind them. Her eyes, nose, lips, and silhouette should appear softly blurred, fragmented, and distorted through the wet surface. Her features remain recognizable but never perfectly clear. Avoid artificial rain overlays, repetitive droplet patterns, or uniformly distributed water.

LIGHTING AND CINEMATIC ATMOSPHERE

Use intensely warm, dramatic low-key lighting resembling a tungsten-lit interior on a dark rainy evening. A large, soft amber light illuminates her forehead, cheekbones, nose, lips, neck, shoulders, and upper torso, creating luminous copper highlights against deep reddish-black shadows.

Her right arm extends forward in a streamlined reach just below the surface, her fingers cutting through the water to create a trail of sparkling bubbles and spreading circular ripples. Her torso is rotated forty-five degrees, highlighting her long slender silhouette and movement line, while her left arm trails naturally alongside her hip. Her long lean legs flutter gently beneath the surface, sending subtle aquatic distortion through the clear depth. Her chin tilts upward toward the moonlit opening above with a serene, focused expression and calm gaze directed toward the cave roof skylight. Her chin is slightly lowered, eyes cast downward, lips softly relaxed. Her right shoulder is closer to the camera and gently illuminated. One arm rests naturally along her side, with her hand touching the fabric near her thigh.
